selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC
Effective: 2 February 2024
Term: 12 months, then month-to-month.
Meridian Energy Partners LLC may not assign this agreement to a competitor of the provider. Other assignments require prior written consent.

selection_rationale: Clause kind 'competitor_assignment_prohibition' on MSA-MER-2024 is classified from the contract header (counterparty/term) and the most relevant assignment, change-of-control, exclusivity, or term language in that file.
known_missing_information: Vocabulary does not define whether assignment_competitor_prohibition and competitor_assignment_prohibition are distinct clause kinds or aliases.
